newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar bearish but closes off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar bearish but closes off lows.

text.p: London's spot December second month March white sugar contracts arrested earlier decines to close off their lows as business slowed towards the close on Friday.
At the close December was $1.10 lower at $308.00, 50 cents off its intraday low, and March was 50 cents down at $305.00, just 10 cents above the day's low.
The December contract turned over 1,412 lots and the March 868 lots to dominate the market.
Both contracts were unchanged from late afternoon levels.
Sugar futures felt continuing pressure on nearby values from mixed sellers throughout the day after a lacklustre raws performance failed to inspire an upturn in sentiment.
Trade and commission house players kept the two nearby contracts weighed down, although light buying kept values off the session lows.
"The market's trend is down and it's in a bit of an oversold situation in both London and New York," he said.
The Matif white sugar market was closed on Friday due to All Saints Day.

In fundamental news, Iran bought three cargoes of Thai and European Union (EU) origin white sugar for shipment in February. It bought one Thai cargo at $322 per tonne, fob, and two EU cargoes at $318 and $317.
Physical brokers said the purchases were made at relatively low prices and formed part of Iran's regular buying programme at this time of year.
